text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Be glad, Meno. I grant you permission to 
attend my tea party.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—What?!? Are you inviting me for tea, 
sir?!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You're not joking...? Orfe-san, who 
usually keeps everyone away saying they 
ruin the taste of her tea just by being in 
sight...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You want to have a lively, fun time once 
in a while, don't you? Right, Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is merely a trifling amusement. You 
should be grateful for the good fortune of 
being present here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Is it truly... only to drink tea, sir...? 
Might there be... some other motive...?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"For instance... taking advantage of a tea 
party to extract confidential information, 
or something—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, could it be... a camouflage to conceal 
a conspiracy moving in secret?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What are you twittering about? Prepare it 
at once.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... If I decline now, their true 
intentions will remain in the dark.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Orfe seems to be in a good mood today... 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Truly... it seems this will be a 
delightful gathering. —Thanks to you, 
Meno-san."
